admission.justification: Sharing an operation resolution removes duplicate captures while preserving one exact pair for records and composition; a real-port count and moved-candidate refusal protect against a faster mismatched response.

applicability: Complete subject/default Intent Reviewer requests wired through the dashboard serving collaborator.
conditions: Composition retains the existing candidate-identity publication recheck, using the same shared capture owner.
Record availability, content, ordering and owner refusals remain the supplied-resolution owners' facts.
exclusions: Independent record-only callers retain their existing entry point.
Entries, summary, focused tree reads and recorded history retain their own request semantics.

evidence: requirements/MIK-R40-v2-reviewer-read-latency-on-git-trees.md rules 2 and 7; exact post-B1 source notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-worker-R2-evidence/final-2026-10-03/candidate-reader-post-b1.json sha256:ff7a5201d4ed37a6d2e109d9a8d3b9374adbd5f44009b7e7f686274ed218b6b2; independent R1/R2 plus notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-review-R3.md (SHA-256 c9a9ea931c18de68182a0f1f12d57cc7e72d29358ed463328ce3d11ca3c988fd); phase-specific performance evidence remains pending

statement: A reviewer request resolves the candidate once and hands that resolution to every part that needs it.
